description: This file defines various data structures, enums, classes, and interfaces used for testing serialization and grain interactions in an Orleans-based project. It includes test data types, enums, classes with complex nested structures, and grain interface definitions.

classes.name: ValueTypeTestData
classes.description: A serializable struct representing test data with an integer value.

classes.name: TestEnum
classes.description: An enum with three values used for testing serialization of enum types.

classes.name: CampaignEnemyTestType
classes.description: An enum with a byte underlying type, representing different enemy types for testing.

classes.name: ClassWithEnumTestData
classes.description: A class containing enum properties for testing serialization of classes with enum fields.

classes.name: LargeTestData
classes.description: A complex class with various fields including strings, arrays, dictionaries, nested classes, and generic classes, used for testing serialization and nested structures.

classes.name: ParamVal
classes.description: A record type with a single integer field, used as a parameter in grain methods.

classes.name: RetVal
classes.description: A record type with a single integer field, used as a return value in grain methods.

classes.name: ImmutableType
classes.description: An immutable class with two readonly integer fields, representing an immutable data structure.

classes.name: EmbeddedImmutable
classes.description: A class containing immutable and mutable properties, including an immutable list, used for testing embedded immutable structures.

classes.name: ClassWithEmbeddedImmutable
classes.description: A sealed class with immutable and mutable fields, used for testing embedded immutable data.

classes.name: StructWithEmbeddedImmutable
classes.description: A struct with immutable and mutable byte array fields, used for testing embedded immutable data in structs.

classes.name: DefaultActivatorValueTypeWithRequiredField
classes.description: A serializable struct with a required field, used for testing default activation and required fields.

classes.name: WithGrainIdType
classes.description: A struct containing a GrainId property, used for testing grain ID handling.

classes.name: WithGrainIdMapType
classes.description: A struct containing a dictionary with GrainId keys, used for testing grain ID mappings.

classes.name: WithGrainIdSetType
classes.description: A struct containing a set of GrainIds, used for testing grain ID sets.

classes.name: DefaultActivatorValueTypeWithUseActivator
classes.description: A struct with a default constructor setting a value, used for testing activation with custom constructors.

methods.name: GetStateData
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve test data from a grain.

methods.name: SetStateData
methods.description: Asynchronous method to set test data in a grain.

methods.name: GetEnemyType
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve an enemy type from a grain.

methods.name: GetClosedGenericValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve a generic value from a grain.

methods.name: GetRetValForParamVal
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve a return value based on a parameter.
